---
title: "Research"
---

My overarching research goal is to contribute to an understanding of the **architecture of human speech processing**. I investigate how acoustic, phonetic, phonological, and cognitive information interacts during speech production and perception.

My research approaches speech as a dynamic process in which linguistic information is shaped by multiple sources of variation, contextual influences, and the interaction of prosodic and segmental information.

## Research themes

### 1. Variation and variability

Speech exhibits substantial variation across speakers, linguistic environments, and communicative situations. I am interested in understanding how this variation emerges, how it is represented, and how listeners accommodate it during speech perception.

### 2. Context effects

Speech processing is influenced by the linguistic and situational context in which speech occurs. My research examines how contextual information shapes the production and perception of speech, and how listeners integrate different sources of information during spoken language processing.

### 3. Lexical prosody and speech processing

My work investigates how prosodic properties of speech, particularly lexical stress, pitch, and duration, contribute to spoken word recognition.

I am particularly interested in how listeners use multiple acoustic cues, how these cues interact during lexical processing, and how their perceptual weighting is shaped by linguistic experience.

## Research approaches

My research combines experimental and quantitative approaches to the study of speech.

**Methods and techniques include:**

- Acoustic analysis of speech
- Speech perception and production experiments
- Eye-tracking during spoken word recognition
- Electroencephalography (EEG)
- Statistical modelling and computational analysis

## Broader perspective

Ultimately, I aim to understand how different levels of linguistic representation and processing interact to support the production, perception, and recognition of spoken language.
